title: Scam, or very manipulative at best
body:
After taking a quiz it lets you pay $1 to unlock the apps, which most would do easily, but it then signs you up for a $40 subscription without any knowing, the $1 fee was not advertised as a free trial as far as I remember.
Not only that, once i immediately went to cancel the subscription, I went through all the steps in the app and it said it was cancelled… only for me to be charged $40 again the next day. And upon blocking the account on my payment app it tries to charge you AGAIN from a different account.

This is incredibly predatory, and not only that but I’m pretty sure all the art is AI generated, who knows if they AI generated everything else too (wouldnt put it past them because the other bundled apps also have just AI generated motivation quotes)

3. If you stick to the basic things, the app is actually easy to use.

title: Not Bad at all
body:
It has some great feature, I wish I had more time to spend on the app and actively pursue all goals! 
The only 'problem' is that is doesn't exactly show you the results on long term and there is no way to just pause the goals while on vacation or to add multiple days into the goals. Once you forgot to check "drink water" for example in a specific day, even if you actually did drank water that day, there is no way to introduce that the following day. 
I was also abit the dissapointed the videos stopped after the first journey but I can understand they can be quite expensive. 
Other than that is amazing!! 
It actually worked for me and some habits are actually implanted in my brain now even without opening the app or seeing the notifications. 
I love the app!
